about: Original songs made for InnerVerse episodes. The list order is the order the app shows: newest batch first, and within one episode in track order. id names the song (and its files and share page, songs/<id>/); episode is the episode's FREE slug (the /episodes/<slug> address); art is the square cover's Squarespace CDN address (Chance sends one per batch), a square image in this folder, or empty to fall back to the episode's thumbnail. After any change here, run: python3 songs/build.py
